## D — Accuracy and source controls for Regulatory signs
The regulatory signs facts are authored from the selected official physical pages and preserve the actor, triggering condition and exceptions described there.
Source confidence is high for page fidelity; current legal applicability is limited by the old edition and recorded freshness debt.
Image-only information has not been converted into unsupported facts; any diagram-dependent learning surface needs its own evidence review.
The preaccept fact-check receipt is same-model review only; independent coverage and fact QA remain pending.
Unresolved visual content: a supplementary sign allowing a right turn without stopping is referenced by position in the extracted text, but its identifying legend is unavailable here (verify PA-SIGNS-VISUAL).
A teen crash-frequency ranking is withheld from stable facts because the snapshot gives no data period for that changing statistic (verify PA-SIGNS-STATISTIC).

corpus_stability.reason: The issuer currently links the PUB 95 (4-21) handbook; no frequent-rewrite evidence is asserted. Edition age and absent effective date remain accuracy debt in part A.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page14 contains a supplementary right-turn sign whose legend is not extracted; identify and bind the actual sign before teaching its exception.
Physical page16 teen crash-ranking statistic lacks a data period and must not be asserted as current stable knowledge.
